description: Switches between sibling panels of content with a row of tabs, such as the sections of a settings page. Arrow keys move between tabs.

handled: role="tab" on aihio-tab with aria-selected and tabindex roving
role="tabpanel" on aihio-tab-panel with aria-labelledby wired to its tab
Arrow keys, Home, End move between tabs

required.requirement: Match each tab's value to exactly one panel's value. Mismatched values leave panels orphaned.

counterExamples.reason: aihio-tab must sit inside an aihio-tab-list; keyboard navigation is bound to the list.
Panel value does not match any tab value; the panel will never activate.

value.description: Stable value that matches a corresponding aihio-tab-panel.

disabled.description: Disables the tab and removes it from keyboard navigation.

aihio-tab-select.description: Fired when the tab is activated; aihio-tabs listens for this to drive selection

value.description: Stable value that matches a corresponding aihio-tab.
